model.name: Phones as scenario units, seed Tron
model.description: Each phone is an ior:class:Phone scenario unit linked to its profile via the relationship pattern, with the standardized +CountryCode-digits format enforced at creation; a profile may carry multiple phones, and Tron's phone +4915253844085 is seeded as the first Phone unit on his WODA.prod profile.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "ior:class:Phone linked to profile. Multiple phones per profile. Standardized format enforced at creation." | TRON (seed answer #1): "Seed Tron's phone +4915253844085 as the FIRST Phone unit linked to his profile on WODA.prod."
model.implRef: ior:file:src/ts/scenario/PhoneIndex.ts (v0.6.69 shipped): normalizePhone L18-23, isValidPhoneKey L26-28, mintAndLink L53-78 [impl:uuid:4242f9be-58d9-4417-8480-000000210006], registerSymlink L38-44

acceptanceCriteria.text: A phone is minted as an ior:class:Phone unit with model { uuid, e164, ownerIor } AND a top-level ownerIor; both ownerIor === ior:instance:<profileUuid>.
model.e164 stores the NORMALIZED canonical key (normalizePhone output), never the raw input string.
The caller supplies the v4 uuid (PhoneIndex is runtime-crypto-free); the server passes crypto.randomUUID().
normalizePhone(raw) strips ALL non-digit characters and returns +<digits> (e.g. '+49 1525 384-4085' -> '+4915253844085').
Input with no digits returns '' (empty), which is rejected downstream.
isValidPhoneKey enforces /^\+\d{6,15}$/ — a leading + then 6..15 digits; an invalid key causes mintAndLink to return null and mint NOTHING.
The standardized +CountryDigits format is enforced AT creation: mintAndLink normalizes and validates before any unit is written.
On success the Phone IOR ior:instance:<phoneUuid> is appended to Profile.model.phones[].
A profile may carry MULTIPLE distinct phones — different normalized keys produce multiple Phone units and multiple phones[] entries.
IDEMPOTENT: minting a phone whose normalized key already exists in phones[] adds NO duplicate unit and NO duplicate phones[] entry.
Idempotency is keyed on the NORMALIZED value — raw variants like '+49 1525 3844085' and '+4915253844085' collapse to the same single entry.
mintAndLink(profileUuid, rawPhone, phoneUuid) returns the normalized key on success, null on an invalid key OR a missing profile.
If the profile does not exist, mintAndLink returns null and mints no unit.

On success an alt/phone/<key>.scenario.json symlink is registered pointing to the PROFILE's canonical file, declared on the Profile's unitLinks[] (self-syncs on write, self-removes on profile remove).
resolveToProfile(rawPhone) normalizes, follows the symlink, and returns the profile uuid — i.e. the phone is an alternate UUID for the profile (feeds R21.3/R21.4).
Tron's phone +4915253844085 exists as the first Phone unit on his WODA.prod profile (real seed data from the start).

testScenarios.name: Phone unit shape
testScenarios.given: an existing profile P and a caller-supplied uuid U
testScenarios.then: an ior:class:Phone unit exists with model {uuid:U, e164:'+4915253844085', ownerIor:'ior:instance:P'} and top-level ownerIor === 'ior:instance:P'

testScenarios.name: invalid key rejected at creation
testScenarios.given: profile P and a too-short/invalid number '12345'
testScenarios.then: it returns null, no Phone unit is written, and P.phones[] is unchanged

testScenarios.name: multiple phones per profile
testScenarios.when: mintAndLink is called with two different valid numbers
testScenarios.then: P.model.phones[] has length 2 and two distinct ior:class:Phone units exist

testScenarios.name: idempotent by normalized key
testScenarios.when: mintAndLink(P, '+49 1525 3844085', U2) is called (same normalized key)
testScenarios.then: P.phones[] still has length 1 and no second Phone unit is minted

testScenarios.name: missing profile -> null
testScenarios.given: a uuid that is not an existing profile
testScenarios.then: it returns null and mints no unit

testScenarios.name: alt symlink + resolve
testScenarios.when: the alt index is inspected and resolveToProfile('+49 1525 384 4085') is called
testScenarios.then: alt/phone/+4915253844085.scenario.json points to P's canonical file, the link is declared on P.unitLinks[], and resolveToProfile returns P

testScenarios.name: Tron seed on WODA.prod
testScenarios.then: it contains an ior:class:Phone unit with e164 === '+4915253844085' as the first Phone
